objective: At every KST midnight close between 1.05 and 1.10 times that day's opening net liquidating equity, inclusive. Start with 150 USDT and roll forward the full actual balance with no external cash. Compute one membership indicator per calendar day. Count idle, losing and above-band days.
data: 31 fixed OKX USDT swaps. Chronological public prints, all six four-hour KST entry windows plus contiguous eight-hour windows. Archive development Sep 22-Oct 21; rule/hour/stop frozen using those days only. Historical chronological test Oct 22-Nov 20, previously observed market period; separately try to extend selected rules with last closed public market day Nov 21. First whole genuinely prospective day Nov 23 KST.
signal: Two-wick reversal only after directional Bollinger walk and short pause, distinct retest in bars 1..30 and first actual favorable tick. 15m directional EMA context for the 5m EMA20 pullback and first reaction. High-volume bullish lower-wick scalp at its close, upper-band bearish upper-wick close for exit by the 20th next candle. Keep one canonical, original-depth profile per side, require nonzero turnover. Entry is next distinct millisecond after a reaction or first public print at/after a scalp close.
gates: cost room: closed ATR5/quote >=0.35% and directional target distance >=0.50% (BB20 midpoint for reversal, outer band for trend/scalp)
pressure: previous complete minute has >=5 prints, >=58% notional on signal side, and >=55% of other observed peers move with the signal in 15 completed minutes
expansion: previous closed ATR5/quote >=0.60%, last 15m turnover >=1.25x mean of four prior 15m blocks
exit_notes: For swing and ATR modes require the best favorable price to cover modeled liquidation costs before locking a net break-even stop. Structural trailing never widens. Quick failure liquidates on the first tradable instant after 15 minutes if the maximum favorable excursion was below 0.45R. Preserve the original single full scalp band exit in all modes. Model stop triggers from trades, filling on the next distinct timestamp with slippage.
budget: PC baseline full-slot 3..5x and comparison capped-risk position <=1/3 of unreserved seed. Keep reserve 3 USDT, 0.5% single-trade risk, 2% aggregate, at most 3 positions and one per symbol and rule; no increase in leverage, no pyramiding. When a full 3x slot cannot cover the structural stop, the capped-risk comparison can take fewer whole contracts. Compare identical signals and initial risk limit. Test daily per-rule caps of 4 and 8.
selection: Rank single-family configurations only on the first 30 archived KST days, for each budget regime. Seek days inside the target band first. Require >=12 fills on >=7 dates, both 15-day halves positive and positive net without the biggest winning fill. Of passing profiles rank first by number of band days, then net minus biggest win minus closed drawdown in USDT, then ordinal. Keep at most one per direction. If none passes, test a fixed best diagnostic with at least 12 fills per direction and label unqualified. Never pick a replacement using test data. Freeze selections before scoring the second half. Re-run the selected joint account, each component, matched quantities and both cost modes; report whether either policy actually meets the band every day.
account_lock: Compare the protected strategy with a lock at 7.5% (midpoint of the requested band). At each eligible valuation check, calculate conservative net liquidation after remaining costs and funding. If above 7.5%, cancel new entries for the rest of the KST day and flatten the strategy's open inventory using the first strictly later executable public prints. No fabricated cap at +7.5%; roll forward the actual value. Compare identical registrations with/without this new account rule. Never modify current live positions during research.
